complete_video_analysis.limitations: Automatic scene boundaries and wording may be approximate; source code and visual tests are separate.

scenes.audio: A digital clicking sound effect mimics the sound of a scroll wheel.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A white digital interface is shown. A cursor scrolls past text blocks in a messaging-style window. The interface is clean and minimalist with light gray accents. The movement is a fast vertical scroll upwards.

scenes.audio: A fast-paced, high-pitched mechanical whirring sound plays, suggesting high-speed processing.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: The camera pans down quickly through a chat log where a link and Chinese text are visible. A small circular icon with a colorful logo appears, followed by a status indicator showing progress. The background is a white gridded workspace.

scenes.audio: Four distinct, rhythmic 'pop' sounds occur as each image thumbnail generates and snaps into place.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: A series of four images appear in a horizontal row within the interface. Each image features a small, yellow, pumpkin-shaped night light with a sad facial expression and tiny brown legs. The images show the product from different angles: a plain front view, a hand pressing the top, a close-up of the texture, and the light illuminated on a nightstand.

scenes.audio: A final, resonant 'ping' sound signals completion, followed by silence.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: The final result is shown centered on the screen. The four marketing images for the pumpkin night light are fully rendered. The lighting in the product photos is warm and soft, contrasting with the bright white digital UI. A mouse cursor hovers near the bottom of the set of images.
